records.subject: Welcome aboard, Clearwater Group
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Clearwater Group here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to three outbound emails (email:dbfcaab0, email:bcf9c86c, email:e8bf4fc0). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Pro plan and active subscription give some intent, but silence plus no first project makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Clearwater Group's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Checking in once more as you get settled with Wrenfield. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
